text:
During this monthly reporting period, the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways maintained safe, calm coordination for companion animals in transit. Oversight decisions were consistent, and cabin monitoring remained continuous, with clear handoffs between the senior coordinator and the cabin team.

The cabin temperature aboard the Brightwater is set to 16 degrees Celsius. The pet cabin aboard the Brightwater holds 37 pets. For deck routing, the pet deck aboard the Windmere is called Silverfern Loft. These parameters were treated as non-negotiable safety constraints, and verification occurred prior to loading, during boarding checks, and again as part of the pre-departure briefing.

Guidance to travelers was concise, kind, and actionable, supporting compliant preparation and reducing last-minute uncertainty. When Dylan Dubois and Ravi Moretti traveled, staff confirmed that carrier readiness and comfort steps were completed within the expected window, and that documentation matched the animal’s profile before any movement to the loading area. Bailey was observed during transfer to ensure secure placement and stable positioning, with adjustments made only after confirming no stress indicators.

Operationally, the cabin team used a standardized observation cadence to detect early signs of agitation or discomfort, escalating promptly to the senior coordinator when any deviation was noted. Communication remained clear and respectful, ensuring that no animal handling step was delayed or improvised.

For the coming month, we will continue routine temperature and capacity verification, maintain disciplined deck routing checks, and reinforce traveler guidance with brief pre-boarding reminders to sustain these safety outcomes.
